runtime_binding.digest_method: SHA-256 of the ordered SHA-256 lines for MapCanvas.tsx, mapPresentation.ts, and every apps/web/public/art/world-map-v2/terrain file

settle_procedure: Waited at least 1.2 seconds after each final fit/zoom/center operation and retained the later settled frame when an initial capture was incomplete.

operator_approval.boundary: Approval covers the exact renderer/runtime-asset digest and six capture hashes in this receipt. Any material bound-byte change requires renewed approval.

limitations: The New Game UI does not expose its generated seed, so the visual receipt binds one untouched live session and exact pixels rather than asserting a seed value.
The in-app browser exposed screenshots and console logs but not Performance Timeline entries; CPU timings and draw-work counts are recorded separately in PERFORMANCE.md.
